Chapter 6730: Seizing Heaven Realm’S Worlds

Chapter 6730: Seizing Heaven Realm’s Worlds

More trees appeared in Heaven Realm since it had nine main worlds and three thousand minor worlds.

Those that had fallen completely into darkness weren’t forgotten. The living beings clinging to life there saw a tree in the sky.

Although the darkness wavered, the beings still suffered like stray dogs, miserable and lost. However, the tree lit the flames of hope in their eyes again.

As for the monsters and fallen overlords hiding in the darkness, they trembled in fear. The light of the tree chased away the darkness, ending its dominion.

In the past, the fallen worlds were utterly contaminated by darkness. This affinity seemed eternal until now. Furthermore, the trees pumped primordial energy into these worlds.

Although it couldn’t change them instantly, the living beings began to see the light and saw hope.

Immortals’ expression soured upon seeing this. They released their incredible powers and reminded the weak of their place.

In one world, a tsunami of darkness crushed the sky, smashing into the primordial tree. Alas, this couldn’t extinguish the light.

“Clank!” The darkness took the form of a great blade for an ultimate slash. This proved to be futile.

The fallen inhabitants trembled in fear at first but heaved a sigh of relief upon seeing the tenacity of the trees.

***

In a ruined world, its boundless land contained no hope, only deathly silence. Remnant tribulations remained, crushing what was left of it.

Only a few lifeforms remained, clinging on in the yellow wasteland. They naturally didn’t wish to live in it, only clinging on to life. There was no way to leave.

However, when they saw the emergence of the tree, they couldn’t believe it. Was the high heaven blessing them with an influx of primordial energy?

They were moved to tears as they showed their gratitude to heaven; some even kissed the ground. They suddenly felt perhaps they could persevere a bit longer with the new energy.

***

In the nine worlds, immortals couldn’t believe what they were seeing.

“The flow is disrupted, this is an attempt to seize dominion over Heaven Realm.” A primordial immortal said.

“The audacity.” An older immortal had an ugly expression.

Heaven Realm had many overlords and immortals. They reigned over worlds with their laws and dao.

Some immortals might have control over a few or a dozen worlds. Their creation dao laid the fabrics for everything.

Because of this, some worlds favorited metals, demons, or spirits...

The presence of the tree in each world caused primordial energy and visions to appear, changing the established laws. Therefore, the immortals in charge wanted to seal their world and banish primordial energy.

“Who is doing this?!” An immortal failed the sealing process and became furious.

“Another person letting go?” Someone eligible to reach the shore read the situation correctly.

In Heaven Realm, only those at the shore were competitive. The ones with a paramita shell were even more impressed.

Whoever it was, this person let go of their body and past. In their memories, only one being outside of the high heaven had done this. However, he had disappeared long ago.
